13_real_leg_structure.legs: Direction A: BUY NYMEX 1 contract ×50 oz using ASK, SELL Tokyo OSE 3 contracts ×500g using BID. Direction B reverse. FX pair uses forward BID/ASK for valuation, but a real hedging forward is not implemented. 50oz≈1,555.17g vs 1,500g in Tokyo; 3.55% unmatched physical metal.

14_entry_exit_algorithm.logic: At matching contract month and overlapping venue sessions, evaluate cash_A=3×500×JP_bid - 1×50×NY_ask×FX_forward_ask, cash_B=1×50×NY_bid×FX_forward_bid -3×500×JP_ask. Signal if max(cash_A,cash_B) - assumed 8,000 JPY roundtrip costs >=10,000 JPY and all quote times within 3 seconds. On edge compression or max 3 20-second quote snapshots, reverse at observed bid/ask. This quote-replay is a research proxy: actual currency forward execution, clearing, financing, transfer/expiry differences not modeled.

15_risk_cost_and_pnl.risk: JPX/OSE 500g contract specification independently identified, but specific month/account permissions and cross-venue delivery equivalence unverified; delivery/clearing not fungible. Non-zero residual metal delta and forward hedge mismatches mean it is NOT riskless. Bid/Ask cannot be assumed simultaneously filled; size/depth and market access unverified.
15_risk_cost_and_pnl.formula: For direction A, entry cashflow research proxy = 1,500g×Tokyo bid JPY/g −50oz×NY ask USD/oz×FX forward ask JPY/USD. Exit reversal = 50oz×NY bid×FX forward bid −1,500g×Tokyo ask. Quote-replay net = entry+exit−assumed 8,000 JPY. Synthetic fixture example gross 70,002.5 JPY and modeled net 62,002.5 JPY, NOT executable trade profit.
